title: 冬支度
subject_en: Winter preparation household items, each ONE item centred in its cell, flat illustration. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: マフラー、手袋、こたつ、ストーブ、毛布、加湿器など、冬支度のイラスト12点。暮らしの記事、チラシ、おたよりのすみに。
items: a pair of knitted mittens with a snowflake pattern
a kotatsu table with a quilt and a tangerine on it
a kerosene heater with a kettle on top
a folded warm blanket with a checked pattern
a long winter coat on a hanger
a hot-water bottle with a knitted cover
a folded warm undershirt and socks
a snow tire with a deep tread
a window with condensation drops and a small cloth
